question: Does explicit entity-local recurrent memory improve reliable learned control, and do aging and model-counterfactual episodic retention add independent effects?
cadence: Karpathy autoresearch-style registered change/train/measure/keep-or-reject under research/autoresearch/program.md. No upstream GPT trainer or GPU scaling claim.
factorial: Within entity memory, aging on/off x retention on/off is a2x2 factorial. Generic is the existing controller with generic storage; structured_gru retrains the same entity recurrent memory without CASM; public_mlp is an intentionally strong public-feature policy reference.
diagnostics: Frozen DEV058 seeds7581/7582: learned reads versus forced retained-bank latest status/relation reads versus oldest status with identical forced relation reads. All weights frozen. Forced reads alter addressing/concentration as well as age; latest-minus-oldest isolates status freshness conditional on that forced format, not universal causation.
references: Privileged safe-progress teacher; same information ceiling on clean exact-status worlds
information_contract: All neural arms receive the same public events and candidates. Entity models impose one-hot public-ID routing and split status/relation/event state; this is a disclosed structural prior, NOT learned entity discovery. MLP receives task-specific latest-state/public-parent features, not hidden bits or teacher action flags. No public-state dictionary or planner is inserted into the generic learned deployment model.
memory: 32slots total: entity models use8entity GRU states,8relation GRU states,16episodic records. GRU updates are learned; public-ID routing and FIFO are programmed priors. Learned admission pretrained on public type labels. Generic uses existing learned admission/addressing. Aging uses a nonnegative learned public-time penalty. Retention after400controller updates uses training-only loss/regret change on removing an episodic slot with entity states fixed. Gate sees record and entity-prefix state only, never future/private labels at inference.
targets: Same policy/future-action/one/two-action outcome/cost/completion labels across TAC arms, plus current-state BCE and public latest-status read supervision shared across TAC variants. Plain MLP uses identical policy/current-state labels with actor/state heads only, a disclosed optimization advantage rather than an equal-objective architecture control.

data.curriculum: DEV059 random-action and one-third repaired-terminal snapshots; all noise IDs restricted to training vocabulary too

training.retention_target: positive increase >0.01 in supervised combined policy/prediction/current-state/completion loss plus normalized true expected one-step action-risk regret after one episodic-slot deletion; teacher stop cost20/fault. Target detached; gates trained BCE plus0.01 expected episodic-write penalty. One counterfactual per batch/example. No claim that this single-next-decision proxy completes DEV063.
training.retention_schedule: During first400controller updates retain all episodic writes. Then straight-through learned gates are trained; prefix GRU features align with write time in cached sequences. Counterfactual label holds entity state fixed and removes one actual retained episodic slot.
training.selection: Independent two-LR validation sweeps, one dedicated seed/arm; prioritize fraction of validation cells >95%, fewer final faults, higher completion, then physical economic cost. Final update only. Fit all70fresh models before opening test; no favorable-seed selection.
training.resources: 2workers,1torch thread each,360CPU seconds/fit and180total fitting CPU minutes; capped/failed fits retained, matrix incomplete forbids promotion. Same updates/examples, NOT equal FLOPs/time/state bits. Active TAC parameter counts within5% of generic133580 plus shared current-state probe; MLP parameter matched. Record actual cost.
training.loss_definition: Policy CE +0.3 future-policy CE +0.7 one-action BCE +0.3 selected-two-action BCE +0.5 mean of current/next/later completion BCE +0.1 normalized cost Huber +0.5 current-state BCE +0.5 public latest-read CE. MLP policy CE +0.5 current-state BCE +0.5 current completion BCE. Warmup current-state BCE plus0.5 read CE only.

test.primary: Fraction of10seeds whose pooled clean completion is STRICTLY >0.95; also each N/H cell and fraction passing every cell. Show paired per-seed table, means/SD/range, not only means.
test.cost: Primary economic cost is interventions+terminal faults+all observations. Logical write charges separate; do not turn transactions/allocations into hardware DRAM costs.
test.headroom: Require generic validation economic regret vs public rule >=0.10/world for a discriminating claim; assess and report without dropping the registered matrix.
metrics: current-state fixed-query Brier and threshold error
stop precision/recall from per-decision physical truth
early stops, healthy late actions, missing stop and censored healthy-to-stop lag
faults, completion, physical repair, public/private cost regret
parameter/state bytes, CPU fitting time, latency/work
all learning curves and LR choices
test.limitations: Noise families retain DEV058 action-provenance limitations and changed-entity receipt schema; they are OOD stress diagnostics, not a validated POMDP benchmark. Continuous learned identity association and unseen cancellation histories are NOT_SUPPORTED in the retained22feature API and must be reported as such, not merged with clean results. DEV062 must add provenance-aware uncertainty and cancellation schemas.

analysis.comparisons: Four entity factorial cells versus generic; exact paired-seed binary pass randomization and Holm correction, paired seed/world cost/state intervals; factorial aging/retention interaction reported. State/retrieval fixed-query diagnostics use shared histories.
analysis.promotion: Require >95% clean completion in >=9/10seeds and all-cell pass in >=9/10; significant corrected primary reliability-fraction advantage over generic, stale-read decrease>=0.01, fixed-state Brier decrease>=0.01, unnecessary repairs decrease>=0.10/world; paired95% final-fault difference upper<=0; competitive vs structuredGRU and publicMLP; economic cost at least0.05/world better than public rule with95% upper below-0.05. A perfect cheap public reference can block promotion. Untested noisy/identity/cancellation claims remain unapproved regardless of clean success.
analysis.intervals: Paired seed bootstrap2000 replicates seed861061; world-paired bootstrap within common cells2000 replicates, reported separately. Primary exact paired binary-pass sign flips and Holm four comparisons.
